# case: 42-share-skills-symlinked-dir-nested
# desc: --share-skills mounts a symlinked directory target and its own nested symlink
# config: apple-darwin
--- exit ---
0
--- runtime-args ---
== container run ==
--rm
-it
--memory
8g
--name
aic-project-<TIME>
-e
HOST_HOME=<HOME>
-e
HOST_UID=<UID>
-e
HOST_GID=<GID>
-w
<PROJ>
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude-contained/claude,dst=<HOME>/.claude
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.codex,dst=<HOME>/.codex
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.copilot,dst=<HOME>/.copilot
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.gemini,dst=<HOME>/.gemini
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.vibe,dst=<HOME>/.vibe
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.m2,dst=<HOME>/.m2
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.vaadin,dst=<HOME>/.vaadin
--mount
type=bind,src=<PROJ>,dst=<PROJ>
-e
TZ=UTC
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude/agents,dst=<HOME>/.claude/agents
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude/commands,dst=<HOME>/.claude/commands
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude/plugins,dst=<HOME>/.claude/plugins
-e
GIT_PROTECT_DIRS=<PROJ>
--dns
1.1.1.1
--mount
type=bind,src=<HOME>/.claude-contained,dst=<HOME>/.claude-contained
--mount
type=bind,src=<PROJ>/skills-src,dst=<HOME>/.claude/skills,readonly
--mount
type=bind,src=<PROJ>/skills-src,dst=<HOME>/.codex/skills,readonly
--mount
type=bind,src=<PROJ>/skills-src,dst=<HOME>/.agents/skills,readonly
--mount
type=bind,src=<PROJ>/skills-src,dst=<HOME>/.copilot/skills,readonly
--mount
type=bind,src=<PROJ>/skills-src,dst=<HOME>/.gemini/skills,readonly
--mount
type=bind,src=<PROJ>/skills-src,dst=<HOME>/.vibe/skills,readonly
--mount
type=bind,src=<PROJ>/skills-src,dst=<PROJ>/skills-src,readonly
--mount
type=bind,src=<PROJ>/target-dir,dst=<PROJ>/target-dir,readonly
--mount
type=bind,src=<PROJ>/nested-target,dst=<PROJ>/nested-target,readonly
claude-contained:latest
/usr/local/bin/shell-run
